stories.title: Navy sailor who died aboard the USS Utah finds final resting place
stories.summary: A U.S. Navy sailor who was killed aboard the USS Utah during the attack on Pearl Harbor nearly 85 years ago is finally heading home.

stories.title: New images reveal stadium-size crater left by humanity's first planetary defense test
stories.summary: NASA's DART spacecraft moved an asteroid called Dimorphos four years ago in humanity's first planetary defense test — a movie-worthy mission to explore whether it's possible to stop an asteroid from hitting Earth. Now, scientists are getting a closer look.

stories.title: 'Frosty's Winter Wonderland' is gone, but Salt Lake City honors the 'joy' it brought
stories.summary: "Frosty's Wonderland" is officially gone, but not forgotten this holiday season.

stories.title: Utah missionary injured in deadly Brazil bus crash returns to burn unit to give back to patients
stories.summary: A Davis County man returned to University Hospital's burn unit one year after surviving a deadly bus crash in Brazil, delivering gifts and hope to patients spending Thanksgiving in recovery.

stories.title: Tech outages are piling up, and AI is raising the stakes. Could this be the new normal?
stories.summary: The era of artificial intelligence has raised the stakes for internet security. As AI tools uncover new vulnerabilities, many other companies and institutions are racing to patch them before they can be targeted by hackers.

stories.title: House Republican leaders tee up major permitting bill in final weeks of majority
stories.summary: The House is poised to vote on a major permitting reform bill during the week of Nov. 30 as Republican leaders look to notch a bipartisan win before handing the reins of Congress over to Democrats.

stories.title: Trump heads to Arizona next week for a high-stakes expansion of TSMC's computer chip factories
stories.summary: President Donald Trump, who has staked his economic policy on growth in the artificial intelligence sector, will travel to Arizona on Dec. 4 to speak at the groundbreaking for a new Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. computer chip foundry, according to both the White House an

stories.title: This woman just ran 7 marathons in 7 days on 7 continents
stories.summary: Utah woman Melissa Walker and 76 others just completed The Great World Race, a fledgling test of endurance in which runners hopscotch the planet in a chartered plane to run 26.2 miles in each continent in just seven days.

stories.title: Small cups, big goal: Salt Lake City students join worldwide record attempt
stories.summary: Students at Ensign Elementary are helping chase a world record through sport stacking, an activity their PE teacher says builds coordination, concentration and confidence.

stories.title: Lake Powell dropped 165 feet. What emerged stunned scientists
stories.summary: Since Lake Powell dropped, ecosystems buried for decades are regrowing — but nothing is protecting them.

stories.title: Man killed in Salt Lake City shooting after disagreement Wednesday
stories.summary: One man was killed in a shooting Wednesday night, police said.

stories.title: Social media firms not liable for the 2022 Buffalo mass shooting, New York's top court says
stories.summary: Facebook, YouTube and other social media giants aren't liable for the racist mass shooting at a supermarket in Buffalo, New York, the state's highest court ruled this week.
